packSummary: The 2015-16 NBA season pack gives Historic Seasons a modern flagship with historical full-season player production, the full schedule/results grid, and a player pool built for Historic Season runs, Draft The Era, and Reimagined Season.
featuredStorylines: Seventy-three wins and unanimous-MVP gravity reshape the fantasy board.
LeBron, Steph, Kawhi, KD, Russ, and Harden collide in one modern historic pool.
The archive gains a modern tentpole with spacing, shot volume, and roster construction that feel different from the 1990s packs.

teamSpotlights.summary: Golden State is the flagship modern path, built around Curry, motion offense, and the most famous regular season of the decade.
Cleveland anchors the LeBron path and the team most associated with the 3-1 Finals comeback.
San Antonio offers a disciplined contender route behind peak Kawhi and a deep veteran core.
Oklahoma City gives the pack an elite superstar tandem universe with Durant and Westbrook.
Toronto adds a strong East contender lane with Lowry and DeRozan leading the way.

modeSummaries.summary: Choose one franchise and guide it through the full 2015-16 historical season.
Remix the full-league 2015-16 player universe and discover what the season becomes with custom rosters.
Launch a fully reshuffled version of 2015-16 and treat the season like an alternate-history branch from day one.

auditNotes: Historical season stats cover every included player who logged official 2015-16 regular-season minutes.
Schedule and results span the full regular season using historical game records.
No synthetic player stat generation is used in this pack path.
